get_redis_client: get a Redis client with automatic connection caching and sentinel fail-over support
get_redis_connection: build a Redis connection with sentinel, cluster, or standalone mode and optional async support
parse_redis_service_url: parse a Redis URL into a dictionary containing username, password, service, port, and db
get_sentinels_from_env: convert comma-separated sentinel hosts and a port string into a list of (host, port) tuples
get_sentinel_url_from_env: build a redis+sentinel URL string from a base Redis URL and comma-separated sentinel hosts
